<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Sp1nd01" />{{rh|The firſt Monarch.|Geneſis.|Babel builded.}}</noinclude>the LORD: wherefore it is ſaide, Euen as Nimrod the mightie hunter before the LORD.

{{verse|10|10}}And the beginning of his kingdome was <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Gr.Babylon''}} Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

{{verse|10|11}}Out of that land ‖{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=‖ ''Or, he went out'' into ''Aſſyria.''}} went forth Aſſhur, and builded Nineueh, and the  ‖{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=‖ ''Or, the ſtreetes of the Citie.''}} citie Rehoboth, and Calah,

{{verse|10|12}}And Reſen betweene Nineueh and Calah: the ſame is a great citie.

{{verse|10|13}}And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

{{verse|10|14}}And Pathruſim, and Caſluhim, (out of whome came Philiſtim,) and Caphtorim.

{{verse|10|15}}¶ And Canaan begate <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Heb.Tzidon''}} Sidon his firſt borne, and Heth,

{{verse|10|16}}And the Iebuſite, and the Emorite, and the Girgaſite,

{{verse|10|17}}And the Hiuite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

{{verse|10|18}}And the Aruadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites ſpread abroad.

{{verse|10|19}}And the border of the Canaanites, was from Sidon, as thou commeſt to Gerar, vnto <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Hebr. Azzah''}} Gaza, as thou goeſt vnto Sodoma and Gomorah, and Admah, ⁊ Zeboim, euen vnto Laſha.

{{verse|10|20}}Theſe {{smaller|are}} the ſonnes of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, {{smaller|and}} in their nations.

{{verse|10|21}}¶ Vnto Shem alſo the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Iaphet the elder, euen to him were {{smaller|children}} borne.

{{verse|10|22}}The *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* 1.Chron.1.17}} children of Shem: Elam, and Aſſhur, and <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Hebr. Arpachſhad''}} Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

{{verse|10|23}}And the children of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Maſh.

{{verse|10|24}}And Arphaxad begate <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Hebr. Shelah''}} Salah, and Salah begate Eber.

{{verse|10|25}}*{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* 1.Chron.1.19.}} And vnto Eber were borne two ſonnes: the name of one {{smaller|was}} Peleg, for in his dayes was the earth diuided, and his brothers name {{smaller|was}} Ioktan.

{{verse|10|26}}And Ioktan begate Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaueth, and Ierah,

{{verse|10|27}}And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

{{verse|10|28}}And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

{{verse|10|29}}And Ophir, and Hauilah, ⁊ Iobab: all theſe {{smaller|were}} the ſonnes of Ioktan.

{{verse|10|30}}And their dwelling was from Meſha, as thou goeſt vnto Sephar, a mount of the Eaſt.

{{verse|10|31}}Theſe {{smaller|are}} the ſonnes of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands after their nations.

{{verse|10|32}}Theſe {{smaller|are}} the families of the ſonnes of Noah after their generations, in their nations: and by theſe were the nations diuided in the earth after the Flood.

==={{Chapter|11|CHAP. XI.}}===

{{smaller block|[[#11:1|1]] One language in the world. [[#11:3|3]] The building of Babel. [[#11:5|5]] The confuſion of tongues. [[#11:10|10]] The generations of Shem. [[#11:27|27]] The generations of Terah the father of Abram. [[#10:31|31]]Terah goeth from Vr to Haran.}}

{{Verse|11|1|notext=}} {{dropinitial|A|image=King James Bible (1611) page A3v (A).png|imgsize=100px}}Nd *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Wiſ.10.5.}} the whole earth was of one <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Hebr.lippe.''}} language, and of one <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Heb.words.''}} ſpeach.

{{verse|11|2}}And it came to paſſe as they iourneyed from the Eaſt, that they found a plaine in the land of Shinar, and they dwelt there.

{{verse|11|3}}And <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Heb. a man ſaid to his neighbour.''}} they ſayd one to another; Goe to, let vs make bricke, and <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''Heb. burne them to a burning.''}} burne them thorowly, And they had bricke for ſtone, and ſlime had they for morter.

{{verse|11|4}}And they ſaid; Goe to, let vs build vs a city and a tower, whoſe top may {{smaller|reach}} vnto heauen, and let vs make vs a name, leſt we be ſcattered abroad vpon the face of the whole earth.

{{verse|11|5}}And the LORD came downe to ſee the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

{{verse|11|6}}And the LORD ſaid; Behold, the people {{smaller|is}} one, and they {{smaller|haue}} all one language: and this they begin to doe: and now nothing will be reſtrained from them, which they haue imagined to doe.

{{verse|11|7}}Goe to, let vs go downe, and there cōfound their language, that they may not vnderſtand one anothers ſpeech.

{{verse|11|8}}So the LORD ſcattered them abroad from thence, vpon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the Citie.

{{verse|11|9}}Therefore is the name of it called <sup>†</sup>{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=† ''That is, Confuſion.''}} Babel, becauſe the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD ſcatter them abroad vpon the face of all the earth.

{{verse|11|10}}¶ *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* 1.Chron.1.17.}} Theſe {{smaller|are}} the generations of Shem. Shem {{smaller|was}} an hundred yeres old,<noinclude>{{right|and}}</noinclude>
